name: Gambit
first_appearance: Uncanny X-Men #266 (Aug. 1990) (cameo in Uncanny X-Men Annual #14)
bio: Cajun thief who charges objects with kinetic energy. Charming, untrustworthy, and the X-Men's resident rogue; his relationship with Rogue is the longest-running romance of the 90s X-Men.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: 90s / Blue-Gold
era.description: Jim Lee's X-Men relaunch through the Onslaught and Apocalypse: The Twelve era. Rogue and Gambit, the Blue and Gold teams, Age of Apocalypse.

relationships.label: The 90s' great slow burn
relationships.summary: A romance built on Rogue being unable to touch anyone and Gambit being unable to be honest with anyone. Spanned betrayals (his Marauders past, the Antarctica abandonment in Uncanny X-Men #350), separations, and the 2018 wedding; still married on Krakoa and after.

events.note: Rogue abandons Gambit in Antarctica after his Mutant Massacre role is revealed.
